3.    Learned APP submitted that first application preferred by the
applicant was rejected by this Court on 26 th February 2021. Since
last one year the applicant is absconding. It is further submitted that
this Court by order dated 24th March 2021 passed in ABA No.483 of
2021 has taken note of the submissions advanced by learned
advocate for applicant in the said application including the
submission that Section 328 of IPC is not attracted in such cases and
said application has been rejected by order dated 24 th March 2021.
It is further submitted that this Court has rejected similar contention
in ABA No.1405 of 2021 and group of matters vide order dated 23 rd
December 2021. Learned APP submitted that while rejecting the said
applications, the order dated 24th March 2021 passed by this Court in
ABA No.483 of 2021 as well as several other decisions were referred
to and submit that Section 328 of IPC is not attracted, has been
rejected.
4.    It is pertinent to note that applicant has been evading arrest
since long.   Vide order dated 26th February 2021 the previous
application for anticipatory bail preferred by applicant was disposed
of. The order indicate that applicant was argued and the Court was
not inclined to grant relief. In such circumstances learned advocate
for applicant had sought permission to withdraw application and the
request was granted. After lapse of one year the applicant has again
moved present application. The issue relating to non applicability of
Section 328 of IPC in case of present nature was dealt with by this
Court vide order dated 24th March 2021 in ABA No.483 of 2021 and

                               ORDER
(i) Anticipatory Bail Application stands rejected.

texts.facts_text: This is an application for anticipatory bail in R registered with Uttan Sagari Police Station for offences under Section 328 r/w 34 of Indian Penal Code and under Sections 41, 88 of Safety and Standards Act, 2006. Previous application preferred by the applicant was withdrawn. The applicant has been evading arrest since long. The issue relating to non-applicability of Section 328 of IPC in cases of this nature was dealt with by this Court in earlier applications.
texts.arguments_petitioner: Learned counsel for applicant submit that previous application was withdrawn. Section 328 is not applicable. The applicant has a good case on merits and there is no evidence to show involvement of the applicant in the crime. The Supreme Court has granted relief of no coercive action in matters, copies of which are annexed to this application.
texts.arguments_respondent: Learned APP submitted that the first application preferred by the applicant was rejected by this Court on 26th February 2021. Since last one year, the applicant is absconding. This Court has rejected similar contentions in previous applications.
texts.reasoning_text: The issue relating to non-applicability of Section 328 of IPC in cases of this nature was dealt with by this Court in earlier applications. The Court has previously rejected similar contentions in other applications.
texts.decision_text: ORDER (i) Anticipatory Bail Application stands rejected.
